output_list.code: function mintToken(address target, uint256 mintedAmount) onlyOwner public{balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount;totalSupply += mintedAmount;}
output_list.reason: The mintToken function allows the owner to mint more tokens than the total supply. This can lead to token devalue. The tokens minted by this function are added to the total supply and the balance of the target address. The owner can mint as many tokens as they want, without any restrictions. This can be exploited by the owner to mint more tokens than the total supply, effectively lowering the value of the token.
